resources.string: Floor Is Lava needs your precise location to place the safe zone and detect when you reach it.

🌋 The floor is lava — for real.

1. Head outside somewhere open and safe, then tap PLAY.

2. Tap START. A green safe zone appears on the map, somewhere nearby that has been checked to be clear of buildings, water, roads and fences.

3. Walk to the safe zone before the timer runs out. The lava creeps in from the edges of your screen as time runs down.

4. Lost? Tap the 📷 camera button for the AR view: point your phone around and a floating marker shows exactly where the zone is.

⚠️ Watch where you're going. Never run into traffic, private property, or anywhere unsafe — no win is worth it.
The lava will win this one.
